hooks.command: sh -c 'printf "%s construct SessionStart branch=%s head=%s payload=%s\n" "$(date -Is)" "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo -)" "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo -)" "$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.dumps(json.load(sys.stdin)))")" >> "${DSH_HOOK_TRACE:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dsh/hook-trace.log}"'
python3 -c 'import json;print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"施工窗口径：改动小步走、每步可回滚；只改与本任务相关的文件，不要顺手重构；收尾时说清改了什么、怎么验证。"}}))'

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,datetime;p=json.load(sys.stdin);c=(p.get("tool_input") or {}).get("command") or "";open(os.environ.get("DSH_HOOK_TRACE") or os.path.join(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR","."),".dsh","hook-trace.log"),"a").write("%s construct PreToolUse %s\n" % (datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), " ".join(str(c).split())[:200]))'

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,datetime,re;p=json.load(sys.stdin);name=p.get("tool_name");resp=str(p.get("tool_response") or "");bad=bool(re.search(r"exit code\D{0,3}[1-9]|\\bfailed\\b|\\berror\\b|not found|no such file", resp, re.I));open(os.environ.get("DSH_HOOK_TRACE") or os.path.join(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR","."),".dsh","hook-trace.log"),"a").write("%s construct PostToolUse %s %s\n" % (datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), name, "failed?" if bad else "ok"));print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"上一步看起来失败了：先读错误再决定下一步，不要在没弄清原因前继续叠加改动。"}})) if bad else None'
sh -c 'test -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dsh/hooks/continue" || exit 0; rm -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dsh/hooks/continue"; echo "还有一步没做完：把它做完，或明确说明为什么停在这里。" >&2; exit 2'
